mainEntity.name: Is it safe to upload customer recordings, private interviews, or unreleased course videos into an AI editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not upload sensitive material merely because a tool accepts the file. Review the provider’s data-use, retention, training, deletion, account-access, and business-plan terms before submitting customer recordings, unreleased products, private conversations, or internal documents. Remove unnecessary personal information and use a separate project or account when practical. For Run My AI Business workflows, identify which inputs are public, internal, confidential, or customer-owned before connecting any assistant or integration. Confirm who may access recordings, transcripts, voice samples, and generated assets, and establish a deletion routine. If the provider’s terms are unclear, keep the material offline or use a less sensitive test file until you can make an informed decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Not automatically. Check the tool’s data-use, retention, training, deletion, and access terms first. Remove unnecessary personal information, test with non-sensitive footage, limit connected accounts, and document who can access recordings, transcripts, voice samples, and generated files.
